instruction: An attic workshop crammed with invention: a drafting table with glowing blueprints, a brass orrery spinning planets, a small tesla coil crackling periodic arcs, gear piles and springs in trays, a half-built automaton torso on the bench, tool walls, a skylight with moonlight, hanging model airships, and a pot-belly stove with a warm glow.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Inventor's Attic Workshop. An attic workshop crammed with invention: a drafting table with glowing blueprints, a brass orrery spinning planets, a small tesla coil crackling periodic arcs, gear piles and springs in trays, a half-built automaton torso on the bench, tool walls, a skylight with moonlight, hanging model airships, and a pot-belly stove with a warm glow. Style: cluttered steampunk. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
